prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: illustrated tabletop game BASE BOARD, without tiles or lettering.
Image 1 is the edit target: the latest Quackies three-biome board. Make a faithful targeted habitat-art revision. The USER FEEDBACK is that the middle grasslands still look too much like the wetlands on the left. Make the two habitats unmistakably distinct at a glance through their vegetation, ground texture and light, not merely a tiny hue change.

LEFT THIRD — COOL FRESH WETLAND: Keep the blue pond, lily pads, willow, reeds and cattails. Give the bank grasses a cool blue-green, teal and sage character, with subtle damp flattened sedge texture and small muted moist-earth traces. Dense upright reeds and waterside foliage frame the pond. Cool reflected water light and deeper fresh green banks. The broad route stays solid, gently grassy and clear, NOT water or stepping stones. Keep the two existing small shelters and the unfinished nest.

MIDDLE THIRD — WARM SUNNY GRASSLAND: This must read as an inviting open temperate wildflower meadow, clearly warmer and drier than the wetland while still lush and green. Replace swampy fern/moss carpets with soft sunlit apple-green and warm yellow-green short meadow turf. Use distinct tufts of taller fine-bladed grasses with delicate straw-gold seed heads ONLY in the planted margins and around shelters, with little daisies, buttercups and a few poppies. Strong warm afternoon sunlight on grass. Fewer low tangled fern masses, more airy open grass texture and deciduous leafy shade around the three shelter structures. Keep all three cozy shelters recognizable in exactly their current positions and scale, while adapting surrounding foliage from marsh ferns to meadow grasses, flowers and broad leaves. Keep the great tree at the top as a warm broadleaf tree. The middle region should feel like a sunny picnic meadow, NOT a yellow-brown savannah, not desert, not a uniform neon lawn. Give the calm route corridor a softly brushed short-grass texture contrasting visibly with the left region's damp sedges. The field is warm GREEN, not yellow dirt. Blend in the short shelter entrances with the meadow turf.

PRESERVE GEOMETRY: Maintain exact board framing, three side-by-side U-shaped biome loops, all route centerlines and full clear width. No plants, tall grass, rocks or new objects in the usable lane centers. Keep the existing eight shelters in their 2 wetland / 3 grassland / 3 desert positions. In particular preserve the corrected LEFT-facing grassy entry spur from the upper middle-island shelter (the alcove around x735,y300 on the 1536x1024 input) to the left-hand meadow lane around x600,y345; there must be NO right-hand spur from that shelter. Keep the other shelter access directions. Keep both wooden bridges, unfinished empty nest at far upper left, and waterfall oasis at far upper right. Keep the right-third desert as it is, warm barren sand and rock with its three refuges, rather than recoloring it with the meadow.

STYLE: Match existing rich playful hand-painted cartoon tabletop art and bold softly drawn foliage. Clear, pleasing cool-wetland / warm-green-meadow / hot-ochre-desert progression. The material and vegetation differences should still read at thumbnail size.
NO new route branches, tile pads, circular wells, tokens, ducks, numbers, reward rows, arrows, writing, legends, borders within islands or UI. Preserve the rounded wooden outside frame and blank cream footer. This is ONLY the base painting with broad unobstructed areas for token spaces to be overlaid later.
